```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(flexdashboard) # dashboard design
library(plotly)        # interactive plots
library(shiny)         # custamize sidebar (filter/radio buttons)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggiraph)
library(kableExtra) # nice tables
library(magrittr) # summarys
library(DT)
library(SpATS) # needs to be loaded in order to plot SpATS results
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
data_file <- "/inputs/input.csv"

df <- if (file.exists(data_file)) {
  fread(data_file)
} else {
  warning("Data file not found: ", data_file, call. = FALSE)
  NULL
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = is.null(df)}
tags$div(
  class = "alert alert-warning",
  tags$h4("Data file not found"),
  tags$p("The dashboard could not start because the data file",
         tags$code("MASTER_SpATS_results.csv"),
         "is missing."),
  tags$p("Mount the data file into the container and restart:"),
  tags$pre("docker run -d -p 3838:3838 \\\n  -v /path/to/MASTER_SpATS_results.csv:/inputs/input.csv:ro \\\n  fieldanalysisviewer")
)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = !is.null(df)}
selectInput("trial", label = "Select Trial", choices = unique(df$field))
selectInput("trait", label = "Select Trait", choices = unique(df$trait), selected = "rdw")
```


Row
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Histogram of Whole Field

```{r, echo = F}

df_filtered <- reactive({
  req(input$trial, input$trait)
  df %>%
    filter(field == input$trial,
          trait == input$trait)
})

# Histogram

renderPlot({

  req(input$trial, input$trait)

  mean_trait_spatially_corrected <- mean(df_filtered()$trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = T)

  #plot
  ggplot(df_filtered(), aes(x = trait_spatially_corrected)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_trait_spatially_corrected, color = "red", linetype = "dotted")+
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Histogram of", input$trait),
      x = input$trait,
      y = "Count"
    )
})
```

### Field Summary Statistics
```{r, echo = FALSE}

field_stat <- reactive({
  req(input$trial, input$trait)
  df_filtered() %>%

    summarise(
      Count = sum(!is.na(trait_spatially_corrected)),
      Missing = sum(is.na(trait_spatially_corrected)),
      Mean = round(mean(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = T), digits = 2),
      SD = round(sd(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = T), digits = 2),
      Min = round(min(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = T), digits = 2),
      Max = round(max(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = T), digits = 2)
    )
})

renderDT({
  field_stat()
})
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Descriptive Stats per Line
```{r, echo = FALSE}

const_stat <- reactive({
  req(input$trial, input$trait)
  df_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      field == input$trial,
      trait == input$trait)  %>%
    group_by(line) %>%
      summarize(
        Count = sum(!is.na(trait_spatially_corrected)),
        mean = round(mean(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2),
        min = round(min(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2),
        max = round(max(trait_spatially_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2),
        number_outlier = sum(outlier == "y"))
})

renderDT({
  const_stat()
})

```


### Outliers per Line

```{r, echo = FALSE}

outlier_list <- reactive({
  req(input$trial, input$trait)
  df_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      field == input$trial,
      trait == input$trait,
      outlier == "y")  %>%
    select(field, year, plot, vector, line, name, rep,row, col, outlier, value = trait_spatially_corrected)  %>%
    mutate(value = round(value, digits = 2))  %>%
    arrange(vector, line, name, rep)
})

renderDT({
  outlier_list()
})

```
